description: Lieux de covoiturage : Mairie de Cruseilles is a dataset listed in transport.data.gouv.fr, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by Mairie de Cruseilles. Open carpooling area data for CC du Pays de Cruseilles. Coverage: CC du Pays de Cruseilles. The portal lists 1 resource (csv) and files the dataset under the type "carpooling-areas". The portal shows 2026-07-07 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-france-transport-data-gouv-national-access-point.
